paragraphs.text: The Gilt-Leaf Wood is a forest at the heart of the elven Gilt-Leaf tribe's realm in Lorwyn .

The capital of the Gilt-Leaf realm, Lys Alana , lay within. Legend says that the Gilt-Leaf Wood was created by Eidren , a shaman of the Perfect caste, known for his skill in shaping living trees. Eidren ordered hundreds of trees uprooted and rearranged into a pattern he deemed beautiful. The Gilt-Leaf Wood is the forest considered most beautiful by the elves. The trees have a sap that elegantly coats the spaces between the bark, and when the sun hits it just right, it seems to be golden and shimmers as if gilded.
